Upstream: https://github.com/TerminalStudio/xterm.dart
Base: pub.dev xterm 4.0.0 (lib/, pubspec.yaml, LICENSE)
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Local patch:
- CustomTextEdit._openInputConnection passes View.of(context).viewId to
  TextInputConfiguration. Flutter Windows rejects a null viewId, leaving
  printable/IME input disconnected while hardware Enter still works.
- Declare Flutter >=3.38.1, matching MDesk's resolved Flutter minimum.

Keep the IME path enabled. hardwareKeyboardOnly is not a substitute because
it bypasses composed text input. Desktop and mobile share this package.
Regression coverage: ../../test/terminal_text_input_test.dart

When upgrading xterm, retain this patch until upstream supplies the view ID.
